Summary
•  Robot Structure
   – Links + joints define DOF and workspace. Articulated arms (6-DOF) are most
        flexible. Material choice affects speed and AI control bandwidth.
•  Actuators
   – DC motors, servos, steppers each suit different tasks. Servo angle → RL

   – Gripper type defines the action space for grasping AI.
       Simpler gripper = simpler RL action space. F/T sensor
       enables compliant control.
•  Sensors
   – Encoders, cameras, LiDAR, IMU feed the AI observation.
